extDescription.message: Start, stop and resume Kimai time entries straight from the browser.

notConfigured.message: The add-on is not configured yet.

errDescShort.message: The description is too short - write at least $CHARS$ characters.

errDescGeneric.message: "$WORD$" tells the client nothing. Write what you are actually doing.

errAuth.message: Token rejected. Check it in the settings.

optTokenHint.message: Kimai panel: Profile > API. The token is not your login password.

optMinDescHint.message: 0 turns the check off. 15 is a good default.

optLangNote.message: The language change applies next time you open the add-on window.

billableOn.message: Billable to the client - click to keep these hours off the invoice

billableOff.message: Not billable (internal) - click to bill these hours to the client

billableLocked.message: Your Kimai account is not allowed to change how this is billed (edit_billable_own_timesheet).

errBillableDenied.message: Your Kimai account cannot set billable / not billable. The entry was saved the way the project defines it. An administrator grants this with the edit_billable_own_timesheet permission.

errNoPermission.message: Without access to that address the add-on cannot reach Kimai.

errBeginFuture.message: The start cannot be in the future.

errEndBeforeBegin.message: The end has to be later than the start.
